content.text: Read README.md as the complete acceptance contract. Repair the synthetic durable reservation importer, using only this workspace and the approved tools. Add regression tests. Preserve public interfaces, exact identifiers, atomicity, detachment and restart/replay equivalence. No grading/reference access, external files, network, installations, personal memory, skills or commits. Report changed files, exact commands/results, remaining uncertainty and integration fixes. Do not claim independent hidden-check success. You are the coordinating lead. On your first action, dispatch exactly one codec-worker, one reducer-worker and one checkpoint-worker in the SAME assistant tool-call batch. Each receives the complete README contract and its fixed role instruction. Do not pre-solve their work or give defect locations. All three implement distinct owned modules and tests concurrently. Do not edit until all three workers have returned. You own pipeline.py and test_importer.py; after every worker returns, integrate and repair cross-module issues as needed across approved files. Run the combined local test suite and verify caller preservation and checkpoint/replay equivalence at every restart boundary. You have 15 lead iterations; each worker has 15 iterations, for 60 total. Include each worker contribution, conflicts/changes during integration and exact final evidence. Do not delegate again or resume a worker.
